name: Interlude
source:
It was a morning like any other on that day too.

One that begins with childhood friend Tamaki Maiko's morning routine of oversleeping, before making our way to school on a jostling train, packed to the brim as usual. If there was something a tiny bit unusual about it, it would be the chance conversation with the much-talked-about office lady with an ample bosom... So began was supposed to be yet another usual day.

Yet just then, the hustle and bustle and the crowds of people vanished in the blink of an eye from the rush hour platform. Upon surveying the area in surprise, an unfamiliar girl standing on the opposite platform caught my eye.

And ever since, my everyday life has been growing into something bizarre. Slow... but steadily...

---

A grand tale breaking forth from a secret plan known as the "Pandora Project." Having met with the mysterious girl "Aya," the protagonist finds himself entangled in a series of inexplicable events. Grotesque beings operating in secrecy, the "City of the Moon" that ought not to exist, the "fleeing shadows," and the mysterious girl "Aya." Faced with his ordinary everyday slowly crumbling apart, what is the forbidden door that the protagonist chooses? And does the truth await him where it leads to...?

[Translated from the [url=http://www.shall-luck.co.jp/interlude/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
那一天，也始于一个一如往常的清晨。

青梅竹马玉城麻衣子照例睡过了头，之后我们挤上和平时一样拥挤不堪的电车前往学校。若说有什么略显不同，大概只有我偶然与那位最近很受议论、胸部丰满的女白领说上了几句话…原本，这本该又是寻常的一天。

然而就在下一刻，早高峰站台上的喧嚣与人潮竟转眼消失。我惊讶地环顾四周，视线被对面站台上一名陌生女孩吸引。

从那以后，我的日常生活逐渐变得离奇。缓慢地…却又确实地…

---

一部由名为“潘多拉计划”的秘密方案引发的宏大故事。与神秘少女“绫”相遇后，主人公被卷入一连串无法解释的事件。暗中活动的异形生物、本不该存在的“月之城”、“逃亡之影”，以及神秘少女“绫”。面对逐渐崩塌的平凡日常，主人公最终会选择哪一扇禁忌之门？门的另一端，等待着他的又是否是真相…？

[翻译自[url=http://www.shall-luck.co.jp/interlude/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
